crossRefs.note: My soul faints for your salvation. I hope in your word.
I have longed for your salvation, Yahweh. Your law is my delight.
I wait for Yahweh. My soul waits. I hope in his word.
I have waited for your salvation, Yahweh.
Offer the sacrifices of righteousness. Put your trust in Yahweh.
Who may ascend to Yahweh’s hill? Who may stand in his holy place?
Whoever offers the sacrifice of thanksgiving glorifies me, and prepares his way so that I will show God’s salvation to…
If anyone desires to do his will, he will know about the teaching, whether it is from God, or if I am speaking from…
This is how we know that we know him: if we keep his commandments.
One who says, “I know him,” and doesn’t keep his commandments, is a liar, and the truth isn’t in him.

translations.web: I have hoped for your salvation, Yahweh. I have done your commandments.
translations.bsb: I wait for Your salvation, O LORD, and I carry out Your commandments.
translations.kjv: LORD, I have hoped for thy salvation, and done thy commandments.
translations.asv: I have hoped for thy salvation, O Jehovah, And have done thy commandments.
